'''Clu Lesser''' was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Banker/Legends|banker]] who lived during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Clu Lesser was the leader of the [[Core Five/Legends|Core Five]] and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] when it was based on [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]].

==Biography==
Clu Lesser was a member of the [[Core Five/Legends|Core Five]] on Scipio. He met with [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] during a time when the latter two were investigating allegations of corruption within the Banking Clan. During an inspection of the [[Main Vault/Legends|Main Vault]], Amidala stole the plans that proved this to be true. [[Nix Card/Legends|Nix Card]], working for [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], got the Core Five into trouble by blaming them for the results of the previous event. Rush Clovis and Amidala later returned to Scipio, where Clu Lesser and the Core Five were put on trial.<ref name="AOF" />
